subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: After the registration-mode bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept the exact `@microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0`/`node-pty` dependency graph and MXC SDK argv-carried config boundary for this official external Windows sandbox plugin?
rationale: The remaining dependency, native binary, install-script, and process-argv exposure questions are security/product boundary choices that code review cannot safely approve automatically.

options.title: Approve Exact Head After Security Review
options.body: Accept the native dependency graph and preview SDK argv boundary for this opt-in external plugin, then approve/rerun dependency guard on the final head.

options.title: Pause For Safer Transport
options.body: Hold the PR until upstream MXC or OpenClaw provides a non-argv config transport for the sandbox envelope.

options.title: Incubate Outside First-Party Release
options.body: Keep MXC out of the official release path until the dependency and sandbox boundary mature.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact Head After Security Review
recommendation.body: Accept the native dependency graph and preview SDK argv boundary for this opt-in external plugin, then approve/rerun dependency guard on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live PR assignee and best available owner for the security/release acceptance decision.
